headline: Walleye Capital to Return $2 Billion to Clients Amid Equities Trading Cutback
summary: Walleye Capital plans to return about $2 billion to clients following its strategic decision to scale back on equities trading.
why: Capital returns and strategy shifts by major hedge funds affect liquidity allocation and asset management industry trends.

impacts.name: Walleye Capital
impacts.why: Returning capital to clients reflects a contraction in deployed assets and trading scope.
